name: tab-mcp
description: Add tab-mcp to a web app: offer a page's functions as MCP tools to AI apps through a tab-mcp relay.

interface.shortDescription: Offer a web page's tools to AI apps.
interface.longDescription: Add @ractive-ch/tab-mcp-client to a web app, register tools WebMCP-style, pair AI apps with a code, confirm consequential tools and run the tab-mcp relay.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use tab-mcp to let AI apps use this web page's features.
